tiers.label: GeForce RTX 20/30
tiers.notes: Tensor cores present; prefer native DLSS SR. FSR/XeSS are fallback paths.

tiers.label: Radeon RX 6000 / RDNA2
tiers.notes: Official FSR 3.1 path first. FSR 4.0.2 is external/experimental only.

tiers.label: Radeon RX 5000 / RDNA1
tiers.notes: Use FSR 3.1 by default; XeSS only after runtime capability probe.

tiers.label: GeForce GTX 16
tiers.notes: No DLSS. Prefer FSR 3.1; XeSS if SM6.4/DP4a path works.

tiers.label: GeForce GTX 10
tiers.notes: Upscaling-first profile; FG disabled by default.

tiers.label: Other legacy GPU
tiers.notes: Conservative fallback. Requires SM6.2+ for modern FSR 3.1 path.
